label: In the unchanged rotating interpretation, the selected base is reflexive, both…, by Direct-proof
meaning: The literal registered rotating interpretation jointly has two distinct necessary universal potential causers and well-founded present-source causal support at every world, but not a well-founded cross-world necessary-support union. Compose its old worldwise-WF and non-union-WF theorems with the newly checked potential roles. Hence worldwise WF cannot replace the union premise of the negative non-distinctness constraint; no metaphysical possibility or failure of every stronger causal theory follows.
